## About
Roswell Auto Center is an independent service center on Alpharetta Highway in Roswell. Our ASE certified technicians work on engines, transmissions, brakes, suspension, electrical systems, heating and air conditioning, on domestic and foreign vehicles alike.
Customers tell us they keep coming back because we give honest feedback, only recommend what the car needs, and charge a fair price. All our work is guaranteed.
We also care about what happens after the work is done. We recycle replaced steel parts and used oil, along with anti-freeze and all types of freon.

## Services
- Full service repair: Automatic and manual transmissions, drive shafts, wheel bearings, fly wheels, brakes, tune-ups, engine repair, exhaust work and air conditioning service.
- Quick oil change and emissions: Drive-through oil changes, tire rotations, trip ready checks and emission testing. With every service we vacuum your car, check fluids and tire pressure, and clean your front windshield.
- State approved emissions facility: We test all year model vehicles and handle the repairs needed to meet Georgia's Clean Air requirements.
- Domestic and foreign vehicles: From Ford and GM to Honda, Toyota, Subaru, BMW, Mercedes, Volvo and more, we're equipped to work on your make.
- Car rental: Ask about a rental car while yours is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 8:00 to 5:00. Our Quick Lube Center is open Saturdays from 8:00 to 3:00. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you work on my make of car?
A: Most likely. We service domestic and foreign vehicles, including Acura, Audi, BMW, Chrysler, Ford, GM, Honda, Lexus, Mercedes, Nissan, Subaru, Toyota, Volkswagen, Volvo and more.

Q: Do you offer a senior discount?
A: Yes. If you're 65 or over, ask us about our senior discount.

Q: Who do I call for a tow after hours?
A: After hours, call United Towing at 770-751-0581.
